item: scripts/guards_for_diff.py --onto REF runs the picked guards on this branch merged onto REF in a scratch worktree (and every run puts the tree it runs in first on PYTHONPATH), so the merged-tree check at merge time is one command
summary: The merged-tree check before a go was a hand-built scratch worktree (20 files and 164 s on 2026-10-28) and its pick was by memory. --onto REF builds a scratch git worktree of REF with this branch's committed HEAD merged into it (a commit of the worktree alone: no hook, signing, signature check, rerere or identity of the user's; no ref moves; a SIGTERM or SIGHUP still removes it), builds the plan there, runs the steps there and removes it (--keep leaves it); a conflict is a named stop listing the files; uncommitted work, a change under src/ and a merge=union file both sides changed are named in a NOTE (a worktree run is the merged-tree check only for a branch touching no src/). MEASURED on one tree (54ab02a13): children started by tests imported the installed tree's src, not the tree under test: 4 tests red in a scratch worktree and in the checkout itself (49 passed of 53 in test_restore_collector_exit.py), 115 of 115 green over the eight restore and WAL files with the tree first on PYTHONPATH, which run() now sets in both modes. TREE_WIDE gained the guards that walk the test files (glob("test_*.py")): the tree-wide pick went from 91 to 94 files. Tests: 68 in test_guards_for_diff.py (32 new), a guard main added is green on the branch and red on the merged tree; 47 of 47 hand-applied mutants fail a test; the Opus read of the first head found the worktree prune, the missing SIGTERM/SIGHUP cleanup, the unneutralised post-checkout hook and merge settings, the merge=union gap and the untracked-files gap (all folded). Stated limits: runs the picked guards, not the suite; the committed HEAD only; a worktree run is accepted only for a branch with no src/ change; a green run is not CI. Docs: --onto and the R349 triage scripts in docs/maintenance/PRE_PUSH_GUARDS.md.
